parameters.name: afterSeq
parameters.description: Returns the events with `seq` greater than this.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: Fetches the tail of the log; ignores `afterSeq`.

parameters.name: actionId
parameters.description: Only the events whose `payload.actionId` is this action — e.g. its `proposed_action.created`, which carries the policy `reason` and `scopeRoot` the action row does not keep (RN-614). Combines with the other parameters; `seq` is no longer contiguous in the page, so a caller filtering by action must not derive omitted counts from it. An empty value is a `400`.
